items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I had a bass player by the name of Jimmy Butts who was a New York bass player

ctx.x: And of course as I said these records that I'm talking about now in '44 had -- I had a bass player by the name of Jimmy Butts who was a New York bass player, and I had a guitarist who was with Cab Calloway. And I had a real fine group there. I made some great tunes and --
Many of them were originals, weren't they?
